lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And she tried to get away (Brendan nods yes) but he was too strong.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And then what did he do to her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well after he was done, that's when he put her back in the jeep in the back.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Was she dead then yet or not?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Brendan, were you there when this happened?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Was she dead there then or not?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: How do you know that? I have a feelin’ I know how you know that.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: We already know Brendan. We already know. Come on. Be honest with us. Be honest with us. We already know, it’s, OK? We gonna help you through this, alright? (Brendan nods “yes”) Tell us, how do you know that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I was outside riding my bike

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Was the door closed at that time?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he know you were out there?
